visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A large group of professional baseball players in matching black jerseys with gold 'Monkeys' branding and white pants are gathered on a dirt field at night. They are clustered together, many smiling and laughing heartily. In the center, a player holds a black baseball glove. Bright stadium floodlights create prominent lens flares and a high-contrast environment. (2) Staff members in casual black t-shirts and a woman in black squat in the foreground to pose for a group photo. Some players in the back rows raise their hands to form half-heart shapes. The camera movement is slightly shaky, suggesting a handheld capture amidst a busy event. (3) A staff member in green shorts moves across the foreground, adjusting the group's positioning. The players remain in high spirits, with some leaning on each other and laughing. White text overlays appear centered on the screen. (4) An Instagram post screenshot featuring photos of players is overlaid on the top right quadrant. The crowd below continues to cheer and gesture as the camera captures the chaotic, joyous atmosphere of the post-ceremony photo session.
